gloss: to restrain; to hold back; to dissuade

definitions.gloss: to restrain; to hold back; to stop someone from acting
definitions.explanation: To physically prevent someone from moving or acting, often by pushing or holding them in place.

definitions.gloss: to dissuade; to talk someone out of something
definitions.explanation: To persuade someone not to do something impulsive or risky, convincing them to reconsider their course of action.

notes:
A compound verb from ⟦{押|お}す→押す：02854_osu⟧ (to push) and ⟦{留|とど}める→留める：10416_todomeru⟧ (to stop, keep in place). Sense 1 implies physical restraint — literally holding someone back from moving or acting. Sense 2 is more figurative — persuading someone not to do something, often something impulsive or risky.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{押|お}し{留|とど}める: to hold someone back
- ⟦{怒|いか}り→怒り：01780_ikari⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{押|お}し{留|とど}める: to hold back one's anger
- ⟦{強|つよ}く→強い：00820_tsuyoi⟧{押|お}し{留|とど}める: to firmly restrain/dissuade

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{引|ひ}き{止|と}める→引き止める：06166_hikitomeru⟧: to detain, hold back — emphasizes pulling back; often used for persuading someone to stay
- ⟦{制止|せいし}→制止：11908_seishi⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to restrain, stop — more formal; often used in official or news contexts
- ⟦{止|と}める→止める：00678_tomeru⟧: to stop — general; lacks the forceful nuance of {押|お}し{留|とど}める
